Parent 124a084df16dbb4c5a68121c670eb0c21a6e7342 still had escape(unescape(newText)). Public master later landed the same hole via squash 5f770a4bdfbac3d8b72bd31ca23340b9285a2d3c (PR #1040); the squash is not the BIC.
